drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find proposed revisions clarifying the scope of confidential information, permitted use and disclosures, and the interaction between the agreement’s term and surviving confidentiality obligations. We have also added customary return/destruction provisions and clarified remedies. These provisions are mutual. Please confirm the parties’ full legal names and propose a governing law and forum for discussion.

edits.text: PARTIES. This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures and takes effect on the date of the last signature below. Each party may act as a disclosing party or receiving party.
edits.name: Parties and effective date

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE AND CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. The parties wish to evaluate a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of a party in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is designated confidential or reasonably should be understood to be confidential given its nature or the circumstances of disclosure, including analyses reflecting that information and the existence and status of discussions. Confidential Information excludes information that the receiving party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes public without breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it without restriction before disclosure; (c) is lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidentiality; or (d) is independently developed without use of the disclosing party’s Confidential Information.
edits.name: Purpose, scope and exclusions

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. In consideration of the parties’ mutual promises, each receiving party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and protect it with at least reasonable care and no less than the care it uses for its own similar confidential information. Disclosure is permitted only to its personnel and professional advisers who need to know for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as these or by professional duties of confidentiality. The receiving party is responsible for their compliance. Disclosure required by law, regulation or legal process is permitted, provided that, to the extent legally permitted, the receiving party gives prompt notice, reasonably cooperates at the disclosing party’s expense in seeking protection, and discloses only what is required. Upon written request, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information, except copies required by law or professional retention requirements and routine backup copies not readily accessible in ordinary operations; retained information remains subject to this Agreement. No intellectual property rights are granted except the limited right to use Confidential Information for the Purpose.
edits.name: Mutual protection and permitted disclosures

edits.text: 3. TERM AND SURVIVAL. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from its effective date unless either party terminates it earlier by written notice. The receiving party’s confidentiality and use obligations survive expiration or termination for three years from each disclosure. For information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law, those obligations continue for as long as the information remains a trade secret. Neither party is obligated to disclose information, continue discussions or enter into any transaction.
edits.name: Term and survival

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES. Either party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief for an actual or threatened breach, subject to applicable law and the court’s discretion, in addition to damages and other available remedies. This Agreement does not establish an automatic entitlement to relief or waive any applicable legal requirements.
edits.name: Mutual remedies

edits.text: PARTIES. This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement is between Northwind Capital [full legal name to be confirmed] and Oakstone Ventures [full legal name to be confirmed] and takes effect on the date of the last signature below. Each party may act as a disclosing party or receiving party.

2. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. In consideration of the parties’ mutual promises, each receiving party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and protect it with at least reasonable care and no less than the care it uses for its own similar confidential information. Disclosure is permitted only to its personnel and professional advisers who need to know for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as these or by professional duties of confidentiality. The receiving party is responsible for their compliance. Disclosure required by law, regulation or legal process is permitted, provided that, to the extent legally permitted, the receiving party gives prompt notice, reasonably cooperates at the disclosing party’s expense in seeking protection, and discloses only what is required. Upon written request, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information and, upon request, provide written certification of compliance identifying any categories of copies retained under the exceptions below. The receiving party may retain only copies required by applicable law and routine backup copies not readily accessible in ordinary operations. Retained copies may be accessed only for legally required retention or disaster recovery and shall remain subject to this Agreement’s confidentiality and use restrictions throughout retention, notwithstanding Section 3. No intellectual property rights are granted except the limited right to use Confidential Information for the Purpose.

3. TERM AND SURVIVAL. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from its effective date unless either party terminates it earlier by written notice. The receiving party’s confidentiality and use obligations survive expiration or termination for five years. For information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law, those obligations continue for as long as the information remains a trade secret. Retained copies remain protected as provided in Section 2. Neither party is obligated to disclose information, continue discussions or enter into any transaction.

5. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-laws principles. Each party submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state courts of the State of New York and the federal courts of the United States located in the Borough of Manhattan, New York City, for any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Agreement, and waives any objection to venue or claim of inconvenient forum in those courts.
